items.html: And these three heads are the aspect of NRN in AA: the skull is the Neshama, the air is the Ruach, and the concealed Hochma is the Nefesh. And after these three heads are explained in general, we shall explain each one of them in detail, and it is as was said in the secret of the generality, that they are three discernments, and also each one of these three is included of these three discernments as well, and this is their detail.
